observations: Two photos show a car engine assembly on a floor, with many sensors/solenoids and fuel/air components visible.
The engine has a serpentine belt and visible alternator/pulley area (photo 1).
No clear engine code/label (e.g., 1AZ/2AZ/2ZR/4-cylinder model) is readable in the photos.
No clear brand/model badge is readable in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos do not show a readable Hyundai/Kia badge or engine code.
No paperwork, shipping label, or markings indicating Belgium/tokunbo are visible.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos show the engine installed/assembled but do not show a test result, mileage proof, or whether it was opened.

risks.risk: Engine identification mismatch (wrong engine family/code for the buyer’s car). Photos don’t show a readable engine code.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate or stamped code on the engine block/head (and the full label if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used 4-cylinder engine with unknown exact code (worst-case fitment risk).

risks.risk: “Working/no knock” not proven remotely; could have internal issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Short video of cold start + idle sound (with engine cover/ECU connected) and a brief run showing no abnormal noise/smoke.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needs inspection/possible faults).

risks.risk: “Never opened/low mileage” not verifiable; could be rebuilt or have worn components.
risks.proof: Photos of cylinder head cover area/fasteners for tampering + compression test results (or leak-down test) screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown condition (worst-case: not low mileage / not guaranteed original).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories or wrong sensors/hoses included (common with engine swaps).
risks.proof: Photo checklist laid out: all sensors, alternator, starter, injectors, coils, throttle body, and any included brackets—plus what is NOT included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as engine assembly only, with accessories/sensors not guaranteed.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID plate or stamped code (photo of the exact characters).
Video of cold start and 5–10 minutes running (sound/no knock, no heavy smoke).
List of included parts vs not included (sensors/injectors/coils/alternator/starter/ECU if applicable) with photos.
response.reason: The photos don’t show a readable engine code/brand/model, and the key claims (tested working, no knock, low mileage, never opened) are not provable from images alone. Without the exact engine identification, a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the comparables.
